control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console HD-1: host directory with package, status, credit score band and a warning for hosts without bank details.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: pageSize (50), scoreInitial, scoreMin, scoreMax (ScoreConfig).

property.name: HostsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, HostCode, NamaHost, Status, Package, Email, JoinDate, InitialScore, CurrentScore, MinimumScore, MaximumScore, plus HasRekening computed in canvas. Optional LedgerScore. Never send KTP, NoRekening, Alamat, PhoneNumber or PersonalEmail.

property.name: ThresholdsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreThreshold: ThresholdID, Label, Description, MinimumScore, MaximumScore, Tone, Active, SortOrder.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON rows of [Schedule - PBS Hub] for the clock-in popup: Title, HostID, Date, StartTime, EndTime, Status. Only days up to today are used.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] for the clock-in popup: HostID, ClockInDate. Days that already have a clock-in are not offered.

property.name: HasMore
property.description-key: true when the server has more hosts than were sent: shows Muat lebih banyak (LOAD_MORE).

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message}. ADD_CLOCK_IN locks until it comes back; message is shown as the banner.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: OPEN_HOST, ADD_HOST, ADD_CLOCK_IN, FILTER_CHANGED, LOAD_MORE, NAV.
